description: A gpt-oss turn as the Harmony format documents it: an analysis message (reasoning), then an assistant commentary message addressed to functions.NAME with the json content type, ending with <|call|>. The model output starts inside the first message (the prompt ends with <|start|>assistant).
markup: <|channel|>analysis<|message|>Need the weather in San Francisco.<|end|><|start|>assistant<|channel|>commentary to=functions.get_weather <|constrain|>json<|message|>{"city":"San Francisco","unit":"fahrenheit"}<|call|>
